name: comp-71
title: Textarea Overlapping Label
blurb: Label hovers over the textarea's top edge with semi-transparent background.
description: A textarea with a label positioned absolutely above and overlapping the top-left corner, creating a compact field layout without sacrificing label visibility.
use_when: You need a space-efficient form field where the label can float over the input border.
avoid_when: On forms where labels need substantial space or users expect labels above the field.
a11y: Label is connected to textarea via htmlFor, respects disabled state with visual feedback.
